extEmailSignature.title: Email signature
extEmailSignature.sub: Your own HTML signature, added below every email you send from Margince. It replaces the workspace template for your mail. Use {name}, {title}, {phone} and {logo} to fill in your details and the company logo.
extEmailSignature.failed: Your signature could not be read
extEmailSignature.saveFailed: Your signature could not be saved
extEmailSignature.needsGrant: Your role does not hold ext_email_signature_signature. An admin grants it in Settings, Roles.
extEmailSignature.hint: Paragraphs, line breaks, bold, italic, underline, links and coloured or sized text are kept. Images other than {logo}, tables and other tags are dropped when sent.
extEmailSignature.previewEmpty: Write a signature to see it here.
extEmailSignature.previewFailed: The preview could not be drawn
extEmailSignature.mode.label: Sign with
extEmailSignature.placeholders: {name}, {title}, {phone} and {logo} are filled in with your name, the title and phone below, and the company logo.
extEmailSignature.switchBack: Saving stops using your HTML signature.
